integrity: The code and complete outputs for three independent computations are embedded with individual integrity digests. The labelled-frame map count does not mod out symmetries.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation covers n at most 5. The all-n finite formula and frontier criterion are proved independently of that census. Specialist prior coverage and independent verification remain open risks.
title: Exact bounded-morphism enumeration from Boolean inclusion frames onto a three-world chain
